newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific Resources ups 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific Resources ups 1997 budget.

text.p: Union Pacific Group Inc said on Wednesday that it has set its 1997 capital spending budget at $1.035 billion, up 18 percent from actual expeditures of about $880 million in 1996.
Development spending is planned at $482 million in 1996, up $57 million from the year before.
Exploratory expenditures are budgeted to total $272 million in 1997, up six percent from 1996.
The budget also includes $156 million for gas value chain assets, which includes gas processing plants, pipelines and marketing.
